description: Download one activity from Garmin Connect and save it as a file on this machine (fit, gpx, tcx, kml or csv), returning its path and size. Use it when the user wants the file itself, e.g. to import into another app; to read an activity's numbers, laps or streams in the answer use get_activity instead. Prefer fit, the original recording, unless the destination needs another format. The file is named <id>.<format> and replaces an earlier download of the same activity and format; every call fetches it from Garmin again.

format.description: fit: original device file; gpx, tcx, kml: track; csv: laps

output_dir.description: Subdirectory of the download directory (GARMIN_FIT_DOWNLOAD_DIR or <data dir>/downloads), e.g. "races"; default the download directory itself. Paths outside it are rejected

name: download_activity_file
title: Download activity file
